notes.title: The demo has launched!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791620/9e293f4ee10893f5f055230c18505acd5a57819f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear fish fans![/p][p]The demo’s live now - whoop whoop!
We hope you enjoy it, feedback is highly appreciated! [/p][p]Also, if you are interested in a beta key, please drop us a line.[/p][p][/p][p]Peace, love and cheers,[/p][p]Andy / Team Octoponx[/p]

notes.title: Demo is on the way!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Fellow fish fans,[/b][/p][p]I hope you're all doing great![/p][p]It's been a while, but we've made good progress recently — and we're aiming to take part in the [b]Steam Next Fest this October[/b]. That means we're doing our best to have a playable demo ready for you in the coming weeks.[/p][p]I started working on this back in 2010, I can’t believe I am actually writing this.

Love, peace and cheers,[/p][p]– Andy / Team Octoponx

[/p]
